# [STORY] As a user, I want the search bar to highlight the words driving my query as I type, so that I understand what the search is reading as operators or entities

## User Story
**As a** user
**I want** the search bar to highlight the words driving my query as I type
**So that** I understand which words are being read as operators (and/or, negation) versus plain search terms

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a user types a query containing "and"/"or", when typing pauses (debounced), then those connector words are visually highlighted distinctly in the search field — `#207`/`#208`/`#209`.
- [x] Given a query contains a negated verb ("didn't direct", "not starring"), when typing pauses, then that phrase is highlighted with a style distinct from connectors — `#209`'s bold wavy underline (`highlightStyles.js`).
- [x] Given a query contains a recognized entity (person name, year, genre), when typing pauses, then that span is highlighted as an entity/value, distinct from connectors and negations — `#209`'s solid underline.
- [x] Given the debounced parse call is still in flight or fails, when that happens, then the field never shows stale or incorrect highlights — it clears or keeps the last valid state — `#208` AC2/AC3, covered by `Search.test.jsx`'s out-of-order-response and failed-parse tests.
- [x] Given a user dictates a query via voice, when the transcript populates the search field, then the same highlighting renders as if it had been typed — this was NOT actually wired until `#210`: `VoiceControl.jsx`'s "search" command used to run the search directly, bypassing `Search.jsx`'s field state and the whole highlighting pipeline. `#210` added a one-shot Redux hand-off (`dictatedQuery`) so a dictated query now runs through the exact same `runParse`/`runSearch` pipeline a typed-and-Entered query does.

Story's span/highlight rendering has anything to consume. Highlighting must
